name: Sausage Nasi Goreng
description: Delicious Indonesian fried rice with sausage, vegetables, and aromatic spices.

instructions.title: Preparation (5 Minutes)
steps: Cook the rice if not using leftover rice.
Slice the sausages, mince the garlic, chop the onion, slice the chili, and dice the carrot.

instructions.title: Cooking the Sausage (5 Minutes)
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large frying pan or wok over medium heat.
Add the sliced sausages and fry until they start to brown (about 2-3 minutes).
Remove the sausages and set aside.

instructions.title: Cooking the Aromatics (3 Minutes)
steps: In the same pan, add another tablespoon of oil if needed.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and fry until fragrant (about 1 minute).
Add the sliced chili and diced carrot, and stir-fry for another 2 minutes.

instructions.title: Finishing the Dish (7 Minutes)
steps: Add the cooked rice to the pan, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Return the sausages to the pan and mix well.
Pour in the soy sauce and sweet soy sauce, and stir to coat the rice evenly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Continue stir-frying for about 3-5 minutes until the rice is heated through and slightly crispy.
Add the chopped green onions and give it a final stir.
Serve hot, garnished with additional green onions and fried egg if desired.
